base.title: Base Plugin
base.introTitle: Build a plugin around a small, clear contract.
base.introBody: Declare the screens in the manifest, expose the C ABI entry point, and ship the bundled UI with the library.
base.structureBody: Keep the host boundary, screen registration, and interface assets easy to find.
base.fileTree:
pom-plugin-base/
├── Cargo.toml
├── src/lib.rs
├── build.rs
├── ui/manifest.json
├── ui/src/screens/
└── i18n/
base.abiBody: A versioned C boundary passes byte slices and JSON between the host and the plugin.
base.manifestBody: Declare menu items, routes, screen exports, locale catalogs, and asset paths in one file.
base.uiBody: Bundle the React screens and styles, then serve them through the plugin asset interface.
base.flowBody: The host reads the manifest, loads the declared screen, and gets its assets from the same plugin.
base.stepOne: Implement the versioned entry point in src/lib.rs.
base.stepTwo: Map each route to a screen export in ui/manifest.json.
base.stepThree: Build and embed the UI assets and locale catalogs.
